nesting: k uses first k of the single random six-method addition order; same four test methods for all k and folds in that repeat
randomization: np.random.default_rng(20261029), reset per dataset; choose4 test without replacement, then permute remaining6

models.fuzzy_LS: 27 rules; frozen LOL orientation/MFs; minimum firing and sum+1e-9 normalization; scene-center design and MOS across k training methods; ridge1e-3 to zero; raw test design times coefficients
models.linear_3f: three frozen-LOL-oriented features; scene-center training features/targets across k methods; StandardScaler+LinearRegression; test features centered within the four test alternatives; no test-label use
models.LOL_prior: same fixed LOL model and test rows for all k; no human-label calibration

preprocessing: existing256x256 INTER_AREA feature caches, same S14 loader/BRISQUE inner join/order and scene conversion; no image loading or feature extraction

metric.name: mean within-scene SRCC over four held-out methods
metric.ties: S14 current average ranks; denominator sqrt(norm2p*norm2y)+1e-12; constant prediction/target scores produce zero
metric.curve: mean and population SD (ddof0) over20 repeats x5 folds =100 values per dataset/model/k

bootstrap.unit: whole original scene; all20 method repeats/models/k kept paired
bootstrap.method: average per-scene differences over20 repeats; resample original scene IDs with replacement; preserve source fold labels and take equal mean of5 resampled fold means
bootstrap.estimand: equal mean over20 repeats x5 fixed folds, matching the coverage curve

prespecified_contrasts.primary: fuzzy LS k6 minus k2, one per dataset
prespecified_contrasts.secondary: for each k, fuzzy LS minus LOL prior and linear-3f minus LOL prior
